translations.literal: Now that the bandit threat is settled, you should withdraw at once.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the bandit threat is settled, you should withdraw at once.

sentences.zh: 其招撫餘兵，或留或散，王與諸大臣商榷行之。

translations.literal: As for pacifying the remaining troops, whether to retain or disperse them, the prince should consult with the great ministers and act accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: As for pacifying the remaining troops, whether to retain or disperse them, the prince should consult with the great ministers and act accordingly.

sentences.zh: 」詔未至，阿濟格率師還京師。

translations.literal: " Before the edict arrived Ajige had already led the army back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Before the edict arrived Ajige had already led the army back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞責阿濟格不候詔班師，又自成未死時，先以死聞，遣人數其罪；

translations.literal: Prince Regent Dorgon rebuked Ajige for withdrawing without awaiting the edict, and for reporting Zicheng dead before he was dead; he sent men to enumerate his offenses;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Regent Dorgon rebuked Ajige for withdrawing without awaiting the edict and for reporting Zicheng dead before he was dead; he sent men to enumerate his offenses;

sentences.zh: 又在午門張蓋坐，召而斥之。

translations.literal: he also sat under an umbrella at the Meridian Gate and summoned and reprimanded him.
translations.idiomatic: he also sat under an umbrella at the Meridian Gate and summoned and reprimanded him.

sentences.zh: 覆議方出師時，脅宣府巡撫李鑒釋逮問赤城道朱壽錅及擅取鄂爾多斯、土默特馬，降郡王。

translations.literal: On further deliberation, when the army had set out he had coerced the Xuanfu governor Li Jian to release the Chicheng circuit intendant Zhu Shou'e, who was under arrest for inquiry, and had seized horses of the Ordos and Tumed on his own authority; his rank was reduced to junwang.
translations.idiomatic: On further deliberation, when the army had set out he had coerced Xuanfu Governor Li Jian to release Circuit Intendant Zhu Shou'e of Chicheng, who was under arrest, and had seized Ordos and Tumed horses on his own authority; his rank was reduced to junwang.

sentences.zh: 尋復之。

translations.literal: Soon it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 五年，剿天津、曹縣土寇。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he suppressed bandits in Tianjin and Caoxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he suppressed bandits in Tianjin and Caoxian.

sentences.zh: 十一月，率師駐大同，薑瓖叛，督兵討之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he led troops stationed at Datong; Jiang Xiang rebelled and he supervised troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he led troops stationed at Datong. Jiang Xiang rebelled and he supervised troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 旋命為平西大將軍，率固山額真巴顏等討瓖。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed Pacification Commissioner General for the West and led gushan ejen Bayan and others against Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Pacification Commissioner General for the West and led gushan ejen Bayan and others against Xiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，瓖將劉遷犯代州，遣博洛赴援，圍乃解。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Xiang's general Liu Qian invaded Daizhou; Bolo was sent to relieve them and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Xiang's general Liu Qian invaded Daizhou; Bolo was sent to relieve them and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞至大同視師，時阿濟格兩福晉病卒，命歸視，阿濟格曰：「攝政王躬攝大政，為國不遑，吾敢以妻死廢國事？

translations.literal: Dorgon came to Datong to inspect the army; at that time both of Ajige's primary consorts died of illness and he was ordered to return to attend them. Ajige said: "The Prince Regent personally holds great government and has no leisure for himself—how dare I abandon state affairs because my wives have died?
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon came to Datong to inspect the army. At that time both of Ajige's primary consorts died of illness and he was ordered to return to attend them. Ajige said, "The Prince Regent personally holds the government and has no leisure for himself—how dare I abandon state affairs because my wives have died?

sentences.zh: 」阿濟格自以功多，告多爾袞曰：「輔政德豫親王徵流寇至慶都，潛身僻地，破潼關、西安不殲其眾，追騰機思不取，功績未著，不當優異其子。

translations.literal: " Ajige, considering his own merit great, told Dorgon: "Prince Deyu, who assisted government, pursued the roving bandits only to Qingdu and hid in remote places; he did not annihilate the enemy when he broke Tong Pass and Xi'an, and did not take Tengjisi when he pursued him—his merit is not clear and his sons should not be favored.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige, considering his own merit great, told Dorgon, "Prince Deyu, who assisted government, pursued roving bandits only to Qingdu and hid in remote places; he did not annihilate the enemy when he broke Tong Pass and Xi'an and did not take Tengjisi when he pursued him—his merit is not clear and his sons should not be favored.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王乃叔父之子，不當稱『叔王』。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng is only the son of an imperial uncle and should not be called 'Imperial Uncle Prince.'
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng is only the son of an imperial uncle and should not be called Imperial Uncle Prince.

sentences.zh: 予乃太祖之子，皇帝之叔，宜稱『叔王』。

translations.literal: I am the Taizu Emperor's son and the emperor's uncle—I ought to be called 'Imperial Uncle Prince.'
translations.idiomatic: I am the Taizu Emperor's son and the emperor's uncle—I ought to be called Imperial Uncle Prince.

sentences.zh: 」多爾袞斥其妄，令勿預部務及交接漢官。

translations.literal: " Dorgon rebuked his presumption and ordered him not to take part in Board affairs or associate with Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon rebuked his presumption and ordered him not to take part in Board affairs or associate with Han officials.

sentences.zh: 尋復偕鞏阿岱攻大同，會降將楊振威斬瓖降，隳其城睥睨五尺，乃還。

translations.literal: Soon he again joined Gongadai in attacking Datong; when the surrendering general Yang Zhenwei beheaded Xiang and submitted, the battlements were razed five chi and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again joined Gongadai in attacking Datong. When the surrendering general Yang Zhenwei beheaded Xiang and submitted, the battlements were razed five chi and the army returned.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，多爾袞薨於喀喇城，阿濟格赴喪次，諸王夜臨，獨不至，召其子郡王勞親以兵脅多爾袞所屬使附己。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year Dorgon died at Karacheng; Ajige went to the mourning place but did not join the princes in the night vigil, summoned his son Prince Laqin with troops to coerce Dorgon's followers to attach themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year Dorgon died at Karacheng. Ajige went to the mourning place but did not join the princes in the night vigil and summoned his son Prince Laqin with troops to coerce Dorgon's followers to attach themselves to him.

sentences.zh: 喪還，上出迎，阿濟格不去佩刀。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned the emperor went out to welcome him; Ajige did not remove the sword at his belt.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin returned the emperor went out to welcome it; Ajige did not remove the sword at his belt.

sentences.zh: 勞親兵至，阿濟格張纛與合軍。

translations.literal: Laqin's troops arrived and Ajige raised his banner and united the armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Laqin's troops arrived Ajige raised his banner and united the armies.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞左右訐阿濟格欲為亂，鄭親王濟爾哈朗等遣人於路監之。

translations.literal: Dorgon's attendants denounced Ajige as intending rebellion; Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others sent men to watch him on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon's attendants denounced Ajige as intending rebellion; Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others sent men to watch him on the road.

sentences.zh: 還京師，議削爵，幽禁。

translations.literal: Back in the capital, it was deliberated to strip his title and imprison him.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital it was deliberated to strip his title and imprison him.

sentences.zh: 逾月，覆議系別室，籍其家，諸子皆黜為庶人。

translations.literal: After a month, on further deliberation he was confined in a separate room, his household was registered, and all his sons were reduced to commoners.
translations.idiomatic: After a month, on further deliberation he was confined in a separate room, his household was registered, and all his sons were reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 十月，監守者告阿濟格將於系所舉火，賜死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the guards reported that Ajige intended to set fire in his place of confinement, and he was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the guards reported that Ajige intended to set fire in his place of confinement, and he was granted death.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格子十一，有爵者三：和度、傅勒赫、勞親。

translations.literal: Ajige had eleven sons; three held noble rank: Heduo, Fulehe, and Laqin.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige had eleven sons; three held noble rank: Heduo, Fulehe, and Laqin.

sentences.zh: 和度，封貝子，先卒。

translations.literal: Heduo was enfeoffed beizi and died first.
translations.idiomatic: Heduo was enfeoffed as beizi and died first.

sentences.zh: 勞親與阿濟格同賜死。

translations.literal: Laqin was granted death together with Ajige.
translations.idiomatic: Laqin was granted death together with Ajige.

sentences.zh: 傅勒赫，初封鎮國公。

translations.literal: Fulehe was first enfeoffed Duke Zhenguo.
translations.idiomatic: Fulehe was first enfeoffed as Duke Zhenguo.

sentences.zh: 坐奪爵，削宗籍。

translations.literal: For an offense his title was taken and he was expelled from the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense his title was taken and he was expelled from the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，諭傅勒赫無罪，復宗籍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year an edict declared Fulehe innocent and restored him to the clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year an edict declared Fulehe innocent and restored him to the clan.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，追封鎮國公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi he was posthumously enfeoffed Duke Zhenguo.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke Zhenguo.

sentences.zh: 子構孳、綽克都，並封輔國公。

translations.literal: His sons Gouzi and Chuokedu were both enfeoffed Duke Fuguo.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Gouzi and Chuokedu were both enfeoffed as Duke Fuguo.

sentences.zh: 綽克都，事聖祖。

translations.literal: Chuokedu served the Kangxi emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Chuokedu served the Kangxi emperor.

sentences.zh: 從董額討王輔臣，守漢中，攻秦州，師無功。

translations.literal: He followed Dong E in campaigning against Wang Fuchen, garrisoned Hanzhong, attacked Qinzhou, and the army achieved no success.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Dong E against Wang Fuchen, garrisoned Hanzhong, attacked Qinzhou, and the army achieved no success.

sentences.zh: 授盛京將軍，又以不稱職，奪爵。

translations.literal: He was appointed Mukden general and again, for incompetence, was deprived of his title.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Mukden general and again, for incompetence, was deprived of his title.

sentences.zh: 上錄阿濟格功，以其子普照仍襲輔國公，坐事奪爵，以其弟經照仍襲輔國公。

translations.literal: The emperor recorded Ajige's merit and allowed his son Puzhao still to inherit Duke Fuguo; for an offense the title was taken and his younger brother Jingzhao was allowed to inherit Duke Fuguo instead.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recorded Ajige's merit and allowed his son Puzhao to inherit Duke Fuguo; for an offense the title was taken and his younger brother Jingzhao was allowed to inherit Duke Fuguo instead.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，普照亦以軍功復爵，卒。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period Puzhao also recovered his title through military merit and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng period Puzhao also recovered his title through military merit and died.

sentences.zh: 世宗諭曰：「普照軍前效力，且其兄女為年羹堯妻，故特予封爵。

translations.literal: The Yongzheng emperor instructed: "Puzhao served effectively on campaign, and his elder brother's daughter was the wife of Nian Gengyao, so a title was specially granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng emperor instructed, "Puzhao served effectively on campaign, and his elder brother's daughter was the wife of Nian Gengyao, so a title was specially granted.

sentences.zh: 今羹堯負恩誅死，此爵不必承襲。

translations.literal: Now that Gengyao has been ungrateful and executed, this title need not be inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Gengyao has been ungrateful and executed, this title need not be inherited.

sentences.zh: 」居數年，經照亦坐事，奪爵。

translations.literal: " After several years Jingzhao also committed an offense and was deprived of his title.
translations.idiomatic: After several years Jingzhao also committed an offense and was deprived of his title.

sentences.zh: 普照、經照皆能詩。

translations.literal: Puzhao and Jingzhao were both able to write poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhao and Jingzhao were both able to write poetry.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十三年，命阿濟格之裔皆復宗籍。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Qianlong the emperor ordered that all descendants of Ajige be restored to the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 the emperor ordered that all descendants of Ajige be restored to the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 經照子孫遞降，以奉恩將軍世襲。

translations.literal: Jingzhao's descendants declined in rank and held feng'en jiangjun in perpetual succession.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao's descendants declined in rank and held feng'en jiangjun in perpetual succession.

sentences.zh: 輔國介直公賴慕布，太祖第十三子。

translations.literal: Duke Fuguo Jiezhi Gong Laimubu was the Taizu Emperor's thirteenth son.
translations.idiomatic: Laimubu, posthumously Duke Fuguo Jiezhi, was the thirteenth son of the Taizu Emperor.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was appointed niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he was appointed niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德四年，與議政。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongde he joined deliberation on government.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 4 he joined deliberation on government.

sentences.zh: 七年，從阿濟格伐明，敗寧遠兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Ajige in campaigning against the Ming and defeated Ningyuan troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Ajige against the Ming and defeated Ningyuan troops.

sentences.zh: 上御篤恭殿賚師，阿濟格不待賞先歸。

translations.literal: The sovereign rewarded the army at the Dugong Hall; Ajige returned before the rewards without waiting.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded the army at the Dugong Hall; Ajige returned before the rewards without waiting.

sentences.zh: 賴慕布坐不勸阻，奪職，罷議政。

translations.literal: Laimubu was punished for failing to dissuade him, was removed from office, and was dismissed from deliberation on government.
translations.idiomatic: Laimubu was punished for failing to dissuade him, was removed from office, and was dismissed from deliberation on government.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，封奉恩將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi he was enfeoffed feng'en jiangjun.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 he was enfeoffed as feng'en jiangjun.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，追封謚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year he was posthumously enfeoffed and given a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year he received posthumous enfeoffment and a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 子來祜，襲。

translations.literal: His son Laihu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Laihu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 累進輔國公。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly advanced to Duke Fuguo.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly advanced to Duke Fuguo.

sentences.zh: 坐事，奪爵。

translations.literal: For an offense his title was taken.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense his title was taken.

sentences.zh: 高宗以其孫紥昆泰襲奉恩將軍，一傳，命停襲。

translations.literal: The Gaozong emperor had his grandson Zhakuntai inherit feng'en jiangjun; after one transmission he ordered the succession to cease.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaozong emperor had his grandson Zhakuntai inherit feng'en jiangjun; after one transmission he ordered the succession to cease.
